---
title: "Language Filename Normalisation"
format: html
filters:
  - gallimaufry
extensions:
  gallimaufry:
    language-filename-normalisation: true
---

## Unknown language classes

Code blocks with unrecognised language classes are retagged to `default`.
The original class is promoted to a `filename` attribute.

```foo
This block's language "foo" is unknown to Pandoc.
It will render as "default" with filename="foo".
```

```my-config
key = "value"
another_key = 42
```

## Known language classes

A block with a recognised language is left unchanged.

```python
print("This stays as Python.")
```
